# shop

Instructions for agents working in the shop service.

## Git

- Never push directly to main.
- Don't force-push a shared branch.
- Do not commit generated files.
- Never skip the hooks.
- Avoid merge commits on feature branches.
- No secrets in the repo.

## Tests

- Never mock the database in integration tests; the fixtures exist for that, and a mocked database has hidden three real bugs this year, each one in a query that only failed against the real engine with real indexes and real collation rules.
- Don't leave a skipped test without an issue number.
- Run `make test` before you push.

## Layout

See `docs/architecture.md` for the layout.
The old runbook lives in `docs/runbook-v1.md`.

## Status

- Waiting on the payments migration before the checkout rewrite can start.
- Run the full verification suite before you push, because the hook and CI run exactly the same command.

shop/CLAUDE.md.content:
# shop

Instructions for agents working in the shop service.

## Git

- Push to a branch and open a pull request; main takes merges only.
- Rebase your own branch freely, and add commits on top of a shared one.
- Leave generated files out of commits: the build makes them.
- Let the hooks run on every commit.
- Rebase feature branches onto main to keep their history linear.
- Keep secrets in the vault and read them from the environment.

## Tests

- Run integration tests against the real database with the fixtures in `testdata/`: a mocked database has hidden three real bugs this year, each one in a query that only failed against the real engine with real indexes and real collation rules, so the real engine is the test that counts.
- Don't leave a skipped test without an issue number.
- Run `make test` before you push.
- Run the slow suite before a release.

## Style

- Write new code in the current style guide's patterns; patterns 1 to 18 predate it, and the linter lists them.

## Release

- Run the full verification suite before you push, because the hook and CI run exactly the same command.
